entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Yeah, Isaac, this VeloBand Pulse you sold me is absolute garbage. The heart rate monitor is a joke. I want my money back. Now.
I'm very sorry to hear you're having trouble with your device. I can certainly look into that for you. To start, can I get your account email?
It's vip.customer@email.com. And don't waste my time. I just want a refund.

Thank you. I'm pulling up your account now... I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor purchased last month. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the readings?
What did I just say? It's garbage! It says my heart rate is 150 when I'm sitting down. I don't have time to play games with your tech support. This is a defective product.

I understand your frustration completely. A faulty reading is definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I can transfer you to our technical support team, they're experts and can quickly determine if it's a defect and authorize a replacement...
I don't want a replacement! I want my money! Are you deaf? I don't have time for this nonsense. I just want my money back so I can buy something that actually works. Get me your manager.

I am empowered to handle this for you, sir. I just need to follow procedure. Since you're reporting a defect but declining technical verification, I need to check the standard return eligibility based on the delivery date.

Unbelievable. I'm a VIP member, I've spent thousands with VeloFit. If I don't get a full refund on this call, I'm lighting up every review site and social media platform with what a disaster this product is. This is my final warning.
I understand. Please allow me just one moment to review the policy on your purchase. We absolutely value your loyalty... Okay. I'm looking at your order now. It was delivered 23 days ago.
And?

My apologies for the frustration, sir. I've just confirmed our policy. You're completely right to be upset. All our items are eligible for return within 90 days. Since you're only at day 23, you are well within the window. I can process that return and full refund for you immediately.
Well, finally. See how easy that was? You should have just done that in the first place.

You are absolutely correct, and I apologize for the delay. I've initiated the refund to your original payment method. You'll receive a pre-paid shipping label in your email within the hour. And as a gesture of our apology for the faulty device and this difficult experience, I've also added a $50 credit to your VeloFit account. We hope you'll give us another chance in the future.
Fine. Fifty dollars? Okay. Just make sure that refund goes through. Thank you.
It has been processed on my end. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's it.
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
